source_text: Post-procedure reliance on non-medical "natural healing" by untrained attendants, eschewing timely clinical intervention, sustains complications like sepsis in 56.2% of hospital-admitted cases, underscoring how resistance to hybrid medical-traditional approaches perpetuates variability absent in vetted practices. [38]
